entities.name: Al-Muzaffar Yusuf I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Malik al-Muzaffar Shams al-Din Yusuf ibn 'Umar more commonly known as Al-Muzaffar Yusuf I, was the second Sultan of Yemen of the Rasulid dynasty from 1249 until his death in 1295.
